en.title: PingCAP Breach Exposes Customer Records and Source Code
en.summary: PingCAP confirmed unauthorized access to internal systems along with the theft of source code and customer-related data. The cyber extortion group FulcrumSec claimed to have stolen 10.6 TB of data including TiDB Cloud control-plane records. PingCAP stated that an external incident response firm found no evidence that the attacker ran commands in reviewed production systems.

claims.text: PingCAP confirmed unauthorized access to internal systems along with the theft of source code and customer-related data.

evidence.quote: PingCAP recently confirmed unauthorized access to its internal systems and the theft of source code and customer-related data.

claims.text: The cyber extortion group FulcrumSec claimed to have stolen 10.6 TB of data including TiDB Cloud control-plane records.

evidence.quote: The attacker, cyber extortion group FulcrumSec, claimed to have stolen 10.6 TB of data , including TiDB Cloud control-plane records

claims.text: PingCAP stated that an external incident response firm found no evidence that the attacker ran commands in reviewed production systems.

evidence.quote: An external incident response firm reviewed PingCAP’s production systems and found no evidence that the attacker ran commands or maintained persistent access in the systems reviewed.

ko.title: 핑캡 보안 침해로 고객 기록과 소스 코드 노출

en.title: Custom skills, agents, and MCP servers in usage metrics API
en.summary: Copilot usage metrics API reports now display specific configured names for organization-created custom agents, skills, MCP servers, slash commands, and plugins instead of generic groupings. Each totals_by_* list now includes up to 25 entries per record, increased from the previous limit of five entries. Prompt mode, the app, and ACP integrations require Copilot CLI version 1.0.97 or later, while the Copilot SDK requires version 1.0.21 or later.

claims.text: Copilot usage metrics API reports now display specific configured names for organization-created custom agents, skills, MCP servers, slash commands, and plugins instead of generic groupings.

evidence.quote: Copilot usage metrics now show the names of the skills, custom agents, Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers, slash commands, and plugins that your organization creates, instead of grouping them under other or custom .

claims.text: Each totals_by_* list now includes up to 25 entries per record, increased from the previous limit of five entries.

evidence.quote: Each totals_by_* list now includes up to 25 entries per record, up from five, so you can see more of the long tail of customizations your developers use.

claims.text: Prompt mode, the app, and ACP integrations require Copilot CLI version 1.0.97 or later, while the Copilot SDK requires version 1.0.21 or later.

evidence.quote: Prompt mode, the app, and ACP integrations require Copilot CLI 1.0.97 or later. The Copilot SDK requires v1.0.21 or later.
